rightsChecker.title: Automated Rights Checker
rightsChecker.subtitle: Answer a few questions to get a plain-language overview of your rights and options.
rightsChecker.q3: Do you have a disability or health condition requiring accommodations?
rightsChecker.q4: Have you been denied benefits (e.g., workers' compensation, LTD)?
rightsChecker.q5: Are you experiencing harassment or discrimination?
rightsChecker.protected: You are protected under human rights law, including the duty to accommodate.
rightsChecker.workplaceRights: You have workplace rights: safety, accommodation, and protection from discrimination.
rightsChecker.noUnion: If no union, consider contacting a legal clinic or advocacy group.
rightsChecker.appeal: You may be eligible to appeal denied benefits. Gather medical evidence and file within deadlines.
rightsChecker.templates: Use our letter templates in Resources to request reconsideration or appeal.
rightsChecker.harassment: Harassment is prohibited. Document incidents and report via proper channels.
rightsChecker.general: Based on your answers, you still maintain general human rights. Consider browsing Resources for guidance.
rightsChecker.copySummaryHint: Copies the current rights summary to the clipboard.
rightsChecker.exportSummaryHint: Opens system share sheet with a text file of your rights summary.

rightsChecker.infoLine1: Answer each question. A plain-language summary appears when all are answered.
rightsChecker.infoLine2: Use Copy to reuse the summary, Export to generate a text file, and Reset to clear answers.
rightsChecker.infoLine3: This tool does not give legal advice; consult official sources.

evidenceLocker.infoLine2: Add notes or attach files. Use Export to create a bundle, Copy to reuse text notes, Share to send a summary.
evidenceLocker.infoLine3: Keep items organized; concise notes help when generating timelines or appeals.
